newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-C-C Amatil view unchanged-DM Grenfell.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-C-C Amatil view unchanged-DM Grenfell.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst Richard Beaurepaire said he had not recently changed his recommendation on softdrink bottler Coca Cola Amatil Ltd, which remained at accumulate.
"There is no change in my recommendation," Beaurepaire told Reuters.
He said the accumulate tag on the stock had been in place for four months.

Beaurepaire said he had written a "quick" two page note about the company in recent days but had not downgraded his recommendation from buy as a Reuters report from New York issued on Wednesday had stated.
The Australian company issued its calendar 1996 profit result on February 14, disappointing investors and leading to a dramatic fall in the share price this week.

"While we remain confident that the stock will ultimately soar once again, the irrefutably positive signs needed to convince a cynical marketplace are still some way off," Beaurepaire said in a seven page report issued on February 14
report and made available to Reuters in Sydney.

"The biggest reason to buy CCL now is that even tighter liquidity will make it exceptionally difficult to assemble a position when the sentiment swings (which it will do strongly at some time within the next 1-3 years," he said.
The company is about 36 percent owned by The Coca Cola Co . -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
